variables.quote: Multi-Family Dwelling                     x      x       x      x     SEP     x    SEP     X       x          x     X       x        x        x

variables.label: Max. height
variables.quote: No building or other structure shall exceed a height of two-and-one-half

variables.label: Min. front / side-rear yard
variables.quote: No building or other structure shall extend within less than fifty (50) feet of any front lot line, nor within twenty-five (25) feet of any side or rear lot line.

variables.label: Multifamily density
variables.quote: Attached single-family units: two-and-half (2.5) units per gross acre of the parcel

variables.label: Min. parcel to create district
variables.quote: Minimum parcel size shall be seventy (70) acres under same ownership in a single continuous

variables.label: ADU approval pathway
variables.value: By-right ("ACC" — Certificate of Use, no special-permit hearing)

variables.label: ADU attachment requirement
variables.quote: the RF-3 District can include the conversion of an existing detached accessory structure or new construction of a detached ADU.

variables.label: ADU owner-occupancy
variables.quote: Either the principal dwelling or accessory apartment shall be occupied by the owner of the premises at all times.

variables.label: ADU size range
variables.value: 400–1,000 sq ft, max 1 bedroom, ≤30% of gross livable floor area
variables.quote: Living area of an accessory apartment shall contain a minimum of four-hundred (400) square feet and shall not exceed a maximum of one-thousand (1,000) square feet; there shall be no more than one (1) bedroom in such apartment.

variables.label: Parking, studio/1BR
variables.quote: Studio, One Bedroom                      1.0 space per unit with adequate driveway turnaround.

variables.label: Parking, 2BR+
variables.quote: Two-Bedroom or more                       2.0 spaces per unit with adequate driveway turnaround.

variables.label: Inclusionary zoning

variables.label: Historic overlay

variables.cite: Local Historic Districts CT database — not independently verified

variables.label: Demolition delay

nza_metrics.label: Residential land with a parking mandate

caveat: Monroe's code does not distinguish a 3-unit tier from larger multifamily — its own definition of "multi-family" legally includes buildings with as few as 2 units.

hap_score.methodology_note: Computed from the Variables table on this page, not from the NZA data below. Six weighted components (Multifamily Access 30pts, Approval Discretion 10pts, Minimum Lot Size 20pts, ADU Approval Pathway 15pts, Parking Mandate 10pts, Demolition Delay 15pts) are each scored against a fixed, published rubric from a specific cited fact above. Higher = more restrictive.

v2.formula: V2 = sum(district score x acres) / sum(acres) over included districts
v2.method: Each district is scored with the same six-component rubric using only its own rules. The score uses four components that every town can document (multifamily access, approval discretion, minimum lot size, ADU pathway); a district is included only if all four are confirmed. Parking and demolition delay are shown as context but not scored, so towns share one scale. The town V2 score is the land-area-weighted mean of included district scores; acreage is from data/land_area/monroe.json. Components with no confirmed input are excluded per district.
